name: Daedong Robotics RT100 TS transport robot
summary: Electric four-wheel-drive transport robot from Korea with a 300 kg lifting and tipping bed that follows a worker (by wire or on its own), drives by remote control or repeats a taught route. Built for orchards, it carried masonry, plastering and fit-out materials on a GS E&C apartment construction site in a 2026 trial.

germany.statusNote: Sold in Korea through Daedong's farm machinery dealers since February 2025 (230 units by April 2026); no European sale, dealer or price found.

specs.label: Bed load
specs.quote: 4륜구동으로 다양한 험로를 쉽게 오르내리며 최대 300kg 적재함과 리프트, 덤프 기능 등을 갖췄다

specs.label: Drive
specs.value: electric, four-wheel drive, turns 360° on the spot
specs.quote: 제자리 360도 회전 기능은 과수농가의 좁은 농로에서 실효성을 발휘한다

specs.label: Operating modes
specs.value: wire follow, autonomous person following, wireless remote control, taught-route autonomy
specs.conditions: wire-follow model from February 2025, autonomous-follow model from April 2025
specs.quote: 유선(와이어) 추종과 자율주행 두 모델로 개발했다

notes: Rough ground: built for bumpy, sloping orchard tracks; on the GS E&C site it drove loaded over slopes and uneven ground (trial report).
Battery-electric and quiet, so it can also work indoors (maker statement in the launch report).
Stops for people or obstacles in its path.

evidence.task: Carried materials for masonry, plastering, building services and finishing between work areas, over slopes and uneven ground, following workers or by remote control
evidence.where: Large apartment construction site in the western Seoul metropolitan area, South Korea (GS E&C)
evidence.note: Proof of concept 7–30 October 2026 with the series model RT100 TS after tests at GS E&C's research site; further validation planned and a robot-as-a-service model is being prepared.
